_comment: Every place on the map carries a trivia theme, and the theme is also what that part of the map LOOKS like. Teams can see both before they choose, so picking a place is picking the subject you would rather be asked about. `spookiness` runs 1-4 and should read as flavour, not as a haunted house: the further in you go, the later it gets.

topics.name: Rock & Ruin
topics.description: Quarries, mining, masonry, geology, things dug up and things built.
topics.terrainStyle: Bare rock. Scree, quarry faces, broken masonry, nothing growing.

topics.name: Root & Rot
topics.description: Trees, fungi, moss, forestry, what grows and what breaks it down.
topics.terrainStyle: Deep dank forest. Closed canopy, moss to the knee, standing deadwood.

topics.name: Fur & Feather
topics.description: Animals, birds, tracks, and the creatures people claim to have seen.
topics.terrainStyle: Meadow and light woods. Open grass, scattered alder, good sightlines.

topics.name: Rain & River
topics.description: Weather, water, floods, fish, tides and the shipping forecast.
topics.terrainStyle: Woodsy creek bottom. Runs right through the map rather than sitting in one place.

topics.name: Grease & Gravel
topics.description: Logging equipment, trucks, roads, chainsaws, anything with a motor.
topics.terrainStyle: Logged out. Stumps, slash piles, churned mud, a road going nowhere.

topics.name: Forms & Procedures
topics.description: Government, paperwork, signage, regulations, the Department itself.
topics.terrainStyle: An abandoned, dilapidated ranger station and its outbuildings.

topics.name: Dark & Distant
topics.description: Night sky, folklore, ghost stories, and what the old-timers say.
topics.terrainStyle: The same forest, at night. Identical ground, wrong light.
